pages.title: Your Ankh
pages.text: The $(gold)Ankh$() is your spiritual protection against the $(curse)Khamsin Curse$(). It appears as a meter that drains when you enter cursed zones.$(br2)When your Ankh reaches zero, the curse begins to take hold. Keep it restored to stay protected.

pages.title: Restoration Items
pages.text: Several items can restore your Ankh:$(br2)$(li)$(item)Pharaoh's Blood$(): Instantly restores Ankh to 100$(li)$(item)Scarab Incense$(): Gradually restores Ankh over time$(li)$(item)Eternal Sigil$(): Removes curse effects + grants protection$(br2)Use $(item)Pharaoh's Blood$() for emergency recovery.

pages.title: Pharaoh's Blood
pages.text: Divine elixir of the pharaohs. Fully restores all Ankh instantly. One of the most valuable items for curse survival.

pages.title: Scarab Incense
pages.text: When burned, restores Ankh gradually and provides protection. A renewable option for Ankh management.
